title: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer

evidence.note: Marks wrote the song (distinct from Robert L. May's 1939 story) and published it himself on January 12, 1949, before St. Nicholas Music Publishing Co. took it up on May 9, 1949.

famous_use: Gene Autry's 1949 recording hit number one on US charts, selling 1.75 million copies that Christmas season.
